about: Mini gold set for track 02, hand-built from corpus text ONLY (written before reading any extractor prompt or output, so it does not share the extractor's blind spots). 10 rules x 20 addresses. Query date 2026-10-01. Rule expectations come from the quoted corpus doc; address expectations come from sample_addresses.csv fields plus those rules. 'applies' = rule in scope and coverage conditions met; 'unknown' = coverage condition (year_built / units) is missing or unresolvable, so 'applies' would be a guess; 'not_yet_effective' = enacted, effective date after the query date; 'not_applicable' = rule must NOT be reported as applies (an 'unknown' or an absent entry both pass, 'applies' fails). A rule not listed for an address is out of scope for it.
coverage_note: Santa Ana, CA has 0 of the 500 sample addresses, so G09/G10 are extraction-only. Berkeley addresses carry no year_built or units, so every Berkeley coverage lookup is legitimately 'unknown'.
